# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are released for the latest 3.x version. Older major versions, including v2, no longer receive updates.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue for security problems. Instead, report them privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/yiliansource/party-js/security/advisories/new) (the "Report a vulnerability" button on the Security tab).

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and which versions are affected. Once a fix is released, the advisory is published, crediting you unless you'd rather stay anonymous.
